name: sandbox-mcp (Windows Sandbox)
summary: MIT CLI and stdio MCP that boots a disposable Windows 11 Sandbox on the operator's PC for app tests, UI automation and detonation reports.
description: Open-source project by Scott Hanselman. The GitHub repository shanselman/sandbox-mcp is MIT (LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2026 Scott Hanselman), not archived, created 2026-11-06 and pushed 2026-11-15T22:34:43Z = 2026-11-15 23:34:43 Europe/Stockholm. Website https://shanselman.github.io/sandbox-mcp/ (HTTP 200; the no-slash URL 301-redirects and is not used as url). Official README: it is not the operator's desktop and not a container pretending to be Windows, but a disposable Windows 11 machine driven by the `sbx` CLI, with an optional MCP adapter for discoverable tools and inline images. Both interfaces use the same engine. Host trust: the sandbox runs on the operator's PC via Windows Sandbox. Official requirements: Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100) or later, Pro / Enterprise / Education; Windows Sandbox is not available on Windows Home or Windows Server. Network modes include on (default NAT), firewall, and off. The latest documented release fetched is v1.2.0 (https://github.com/shanselman/sandbox-mcp/releases/tag/v1.2.0, HTTP 200): portable CLI plus optional MCP server, bundled Node.js, guest agent and setup instructions; no separate Node/npm install needed. The official agent-setup prompt and any install or MCP config were not run, and no release binary was downloaded. For an MCP client the README shows a stdio server example under the name "windows-sandbox" pointing at the extracted ZIP's bundled runtime; there is no hosted remote MCP endpoint. Official wording: the CLI must work without MCP; configure the optional adapter only if the agent needs it, and ask before admin changes or a restart. Cost is described as free with Windows Pro/Enterprise (the Windows license the operator already has). No signup or spend.

agent_access.notes: No hosted MCP endpoint. Official README: local stdio MCP adapter plus a `sbx` CLI, running Windows Sandbox on the operator's machine (Windows 11 24H2+ Pro/Enterprise/Education, not Home or Server). The v1.2.0 release and agent-setup instructions were not downloaded or executed, and the local server was not started or probed. Network modes include on, firewall, and off.
